title: AI Lifecycle-Aware Feasibility Framework for Split-RIC Orchestration in NTN O-RAN
abstract: arXiv:2603.23252v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) into Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) is constrained by the joint limits of satellite Size, Weight, and Power (SWaP), feeder-link capacity, and orbital connectivity, which directly affect O-RAN closed-loop control and AI lifecycle management. This paper studies the feasibility of distributing the O-RAN intelligence across Ground, LEO, and GEO segments through three representative deployments: (i) Ground-Centric control with telemetry streaming, (ii) a ground-LEO Split-RIC with on-board inference and store-and-forward model refresh, and (iii) GEO-LEO multi-layer control enabled by inter-satellite links. For each deployment, we derive closed-form expressions for lifecycle energy, near-real-time control latency, and model-refresh latency, while explicitly enforcing power-feasible spaceborne computational throughput. translated_title: 面向NTN O-RAN中Split-RIC编排的AI生命周期感知可行性框架
translated_abstract: 将人工智能（AI）集成到非地面网络（NTN）中受到卫星尺寸、重量和功率（SWaP）的联合限制、馈电链路容量以及轨道连接性的制约，这些因素直接影响O-RAN闭环控制和AI生命周期管理。本文研究了通过三种代表性部署将O-RAN智能分布到地面段、LEO段和GEO段的可行性：（i）带遥测数据流的地面中心控制，（ii）具备星载推理和存储转发模型更新的地面-LEO Split-RIC，以及（iii）由星间链路实现的GEO-LEO多层控制。针对每种部署，我们推导了生命周期能耗、近实时控制延迟和模型更新延迟的闭式表达式，同时显式地保证星载计算吞吐量在功率可行范围内。此外，还提供了各部署方案之间的成对解析边界以及基于遥测数据的数值敏感性分析。
tldr: 本文提出一个AI生命周期感知的可行性框架，通过推导生命周期能耗、近实时控制延迟和模型更新延迟的闭式表达式，系统评估了地面、LEO和GEO三种Split-RIC部署方案在NTN O-RAN中分发AI智能的功率与延迟可行性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an AI lifecycle-aware feasibility framework that derives closed-form expressions for lifecycle energy, near-real-time control latency, and model-refresh latency to assess the feasibility of three Ground/LEO/GEO Split-RIC deployment options for distributing O-RAN intelligence in NTN O-RAN.
